predictions.prediction: If, in late 2021 or early 2022, Senator Joe Manchin kills the Build Back Better bill and further large-scale fiscal stimulus is halted, then in calendar year 2022 the U.S. economy will experience a "massive relief rally" (substantial positive move in risk asset prices) and strong economic performance, and the Federal Reserve will not need to raise interest rates as aggressively as otherwise projected, resulting in a relatively soft economic landing rather than a sharp downturn.
